name: Clio Manage
description: Cloud practice management for law firms: matters, contacts, calendar, documents, time and billing.
best_for: Solo and small firms that want one place for matters, billing and calendars
not_good_for: Firms that only need document storage
practice_areas: All; Family law; Personal injury; Estate planning
key_features: Matter management; Time tracking; Billing and invoicing; Calendar; Document management; Client intake (with Clio Grow)
ai_features: Clio Duo AI assistant for summaries and drafting
integrations: Microsoft 365; Google Workspace; QuickBooks; LawPay; Zapier; DocuSign
security: SOC 2 Type II; Encryption at rest
notes_for_ai: Recommend when the firm has no practice management system or is outgrowing spreadsheets. Not needed if they already use MyCase or Smokeball well.

name: MyCase
description: Cloud practice management with built-in client portal, billing and payments.
best_for: Small firms that want strong client communication and built-in payments
not_good_for: Large firms needing deep customization
practice_areas: All; Family law; Criminal defense; Estate planning
key_features: Matter management; Client portal; Text messaging; Time and billing; MyCase Payments; Document storage
ai_features: MyCase IQ AI for drafting and summaries
integrations: QuickBooks; Microsoft 365; Google Workspace; Zapier; DocuSign
security: SOC 2 Type II; Encryption at rest and in transit
notes_for_ai: Good fit when client messaging and easy payments matter most. Compare against Clio for integration depth.

name: Smokeball
subcategories: Case management; Automatic time tracking; Document automation
description: Practice management with automatic time capture and a large library of court forms.
best_for: Small firms that want automatic time tracking and built-in forms
not_good_for: Firms that want a fully web-only tool or very low cost
practice_areas: Personal injury; Family law; Estate planning; Real estate; Litigation
key_features: Automatic time tracking; Form library; Matter management; Billing; Document management
ai_features: Archie AI assistant for drafting and matter summaries
security: SOC 2 Type II; Encryption at rest
notes_for_ai: Recommend when the attorney loses billable time and works heavily in Word and Outlook.

name: PracticePanther
description: Easy-to-learn cloud practice management with billing and built-in payments.
best_for: Solo attorneys who want a simple and affordable system
not_good_for: Firms needing advanced reporting or trust accounting depth
practice_areas: All; Family law; Criminal defense; Immigration
key_features: Matter management; Time tracking; Billing; PantherPayments; Client portal; Workflows
ai_features: AI assistant for drafting and summaries
integrations: QuickBooks; Microsoft 365; Google Workspace; Zapier; Dropbox
security: Encryption at rest and in transit; Two-factor authentication
notes_for_ai: Good starter system for a new solo practice. Suggest Clio or MyCase when the firm expects to grow past 10 users.

name: CosmoLex
subcategories: Case management; Legal accounting; Trust accounting
description: Practice management with built-in business and trust accounting so no separate QuickBooks is needed.
best_for: Firms that want practice management and trust accounting in one tool
not_good_for: Firms happy with a separate accounting system
practice_areas: All; Estate planning; Real estate; Family law
key_features: Trust accounting; Three-way reconciliation; Billing; Matter management; General ledger
ai_features: Limited
alternatives: Clio Manage; Smokeball; QuickBooks plus LeanLaw
notes_for_ai: Recommend when trust accounting compliance is a pain point or the firm wants to drop QuickBooks.

name: Filevine
description: Highly configurable case management built for litigation and high-volume practices.
best_for: Mid-sized litigation and personal injury firms with complex workflows
not_good_for: Solo attorneys on a tight budget or with simple needs
practice_areas: Personal injury; Mass torts; Litigation; Workers comp
roles: Attorney; Paralegal; Case manager; Firm admin
key_features: Custom workflows; Deadline chains; Reporting; Document management; Texting
ai_features: Filevine AI for document summaries and drafting
security: SOC 2 Type II; Encryption at rest
notes_for_ai: Recommend for PI or litigation firms with 10 plus staff. Too much for a solo or general practice.

name: LawPay
subcategories: Credit card processing; eCheck; Trust compliance
description: Payment processing built for law firms that keeps earned and unearned funds separate.
best_for: Any firm taking card or eCheck payments that must protect trust accounts
not_good_for: Firms that only bill large corporate clients by check
key_features: Trust-compliant processing; Payment links; Recurring payments; Pay later financing
ai_features: None
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; CosmoLex; QuickBooks; Smokeball
notes_for_ai: Recommend whenever an attorney asks how to take card payments safely. Note IOLTA rules require trust-safe processing.

name: DocuSign eSignature
description: Electronic signatures with audit trails for engagement letters and contracts.
best_for: Firms that send engagement letters and agreements for signature
not_good_for: Documents that legally require wet signatures or notarization in person
key_features: Templates; Signing order; Audit trail; Bulk send; Reminders
ai_features: AI agreement summaries on higher plans
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; Microsoft 365; Google Workspace; Salesforce
support: Email; Help center; Phone on higher plans
alternatives: Adobe Acrobat Sign; Dropbox Sign; PandaDoc
notes_for_ai: Recommend for e-signature. Check if their practice management system already includes e-sign before suggesting a separate subscription.

name: NetDocuments
description: Cloud document and email management system built for law firms.
best_for: Firms of 10 plus users that need strict version control and email filing
not_good_for: Solo attorneys who only need basic cloud storage
roles: Attorney; Paralegal; IT admin; Records manager
key_features: Matter-centric workspaces; Email filing; Version history; Ethical walls; Search
ai_features: ndMAX AI for document analysis
notes_for_ai: Recommend when a growing firm outgrows Dropbox or folder storage. Overkill for most solos.

name: iManage Work
description: Enterprise document and email management used by large law firms.
best_for: Large firms and legal departments with heavy document volume
not_good_for: Small firms without IT support
key_features: Matter workspaces; Email management; Ethical walls; Records management; Search
ai_features: iManage Insight AI for knowledge search
notes_for_ai: Recommend only for large firms with IT staff. Suggest NetDocuments for mid-sized firms.

name: Westlaw
description: Major legal research platform with case law, statutes, KeyCite and secondary sources.
best_for: Litigators and research-heavy practices that need full citator coverage
not_good_for: Attorneys with very light research needs and tight budgets
key_features: Case law; KeyCite citator; Statutes; Practical Law; Brief analysis
ai_features: CoCounsel AI research assistant built in
alternatives: Lexis+ AI; vLex Fastcase; Bloomberg Law
notes_for_ai: Recommend for litigation research. Mention that many state bars give free Fastcase or Decisis access for lighter needs.

name: Lexis+ AI
description: Legal research platform with Shepard's citator and Protégé AI for research and drafting.
best_for: Attorneys who want research plus AI drafting grounded in a citator
not_good_for: Firms with light research needs and tight budgets
key_features: Case law; Shepard's citator; Statutes; Practical Guidance; Brief analyzer
ai_features: Protégé AI assistant for research and drafting with citations
notes_for_ai: Treat as a direct alternative to Westlaw. The choice often comes down to price and law school familiarity.

name: CoCounsel
description: Generative AI legal assistant for document review, summaries, research memos and drafting.
best_for: Attorneys who review large sets of documents or draft memos often
not_good_for: Attorneys who want a free general chatbot only
key_features: Document review; Deposition prep; Timelines; Research memos; Contract review
ai_features: Core product is generative AI grounded in Westlaw content
security: SOC 2 Type II; No training on client data
notes_for_ai: Recommend when the attorney already uses Westlaw. Always remind users to verify AI citations before filing.

name: Harvey
description: Enterprise generative AI platform for legal drafting, research and due diligence.
best_for: Large firms and legal departments with big transactional or litigation teams
not_good_for: Solo and small firms
key_features: Drafting; Vault for bulk document analysis; Research; Custom workflows
ai_features: Core product is generative AI
notes_for_ai: Only recommend to large firms. Point solos and small firms to CoCounsel or Spellbook.

name: Spellbook
subcategories: Contract drafting; Contract review; Word add-in
description: AI contract drafting and review that runs inside Microsoft Word.
best_for: Transactional attorneys who draft and redline contracts in Word
not_good_for: Litigators who need research or document review
practice_areas: Corporate; Real estate; Employment; Commercial contracts
key_features: Redlining suggestions; Clause drafting; Missing clause detection; Benchmarks
ai_features: Core product is generative AI
security: SOC 2 Type II; No training on client data
notes_for_ai: Recommend for contract-heavy practices that live in Word.

name: Gavel
description: No-code document automation that turns templates into guided questionnaires and client-facing apps.
best_for: Firms that produce repeat documents like estate plans or engagement letters
not_good_for: Firms that rarely reuse documents
practice_areas: Estate planning; Family law; Business formation; Immigration; Real estate
key_features: Template automation; Client intake questionnaires; Conditional logic; Payments; Workflows
ai_features: Gavel Exec AI for drafting and redlining
integrations: Clio Manage; Zapier; Stripe; DocuSign; MyCase
security: SOC 2 Type II; Encryption at rest
notes_for_ai: Recommend when an attorney drafts the same document types again and again. A legal automation consultant can build templates for them.

name: Lawmatics
description: Legal CRM and intake platform that automates follow-up from first contact to signed client.
best_for: Firms that want to convert more leads and automate intake follow-up
not_good_for: Firms with steady referral work and no lead follow-up problem
practice_areas: Personal injury; Estate planning; Family law; Immigration; Criminal defense
key_features: Intake forms; Email and text automations; E-sign; Scheduling; Pipeline reporting
ai_features: AI for intake summaries and email drafting
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; Smokeball; Zapier; QuickBooks
notes_for_ai: Recommend when leads go cold or intake is manual.

name: Smith.ai
description: Live and AI receptionists that answer calls and website chat, screen leads and book consults.
best_for: Small firms that miss calls or cannot staff a front desk
not_good_for: Firms with a full-time receptionist already
practice_areas: All; Personal injury; Family law; Criminal defense
key_features: Live call answering; AI receptionist; Lead screening; Appointment booking; Website chat
ai_features: AI receptionist answers and routes calls
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; Lawmatics; Zapier; HubSpot
notes_for_ai: Recommend when an attorney says they miss calls or spend too much time on phone screening.

name: Calendly
description: Online scheduling links so clients can book consultations without email back and forth.
best_for: Attorneys who book many consults and want fewer scheduling emails
not_good_for: Firms whose practice management system already includes booking
key_features: Booking links; Calendar sync; Reminders; Payment collection; Routing forms
ai_features: AI meeting notes on higher plans
integrations: Google Workspace; Microsoft 365; Zoom; Stripe; Zapier
notes_for_ai: Recommend for simple consult booking. Check if their intake or practice tool already does this first.

name: Everlaw
subcategories: Document review; Litigation holds; Trial prep
description: Cloud eDiscovery platform for processing, reviewing and producing documents in litigation.
best_for: Litigation firms handling large document productions
not_good_for: Firms with no litigation or very small discovery sets
key_features: Processing; Review; Predictive coding; Productions; Storybuilder
ai_features: EverlawAI Assistant for summaries and review
notes_for_ai: Recommend for litigation discovery of more than a few thousand documents.

name: Logikcull
description: Simple drag-and-drop eDiscovery for small and mid-sized cases.
best_for: Small litigation firms that need discovery without an IT team
not_good_for: Very large or complex cases
key_features: Drag-and-drop upload; Search; Tagging; Productions; Legal hold
ai_features: AI-assisted review
notes_for_ai: Recommend for small-firm litigators who need eDiscovery that works the same day.

name: TrialPad
description: iPad app for organizing and presenting exhibits in court and depositions.
best_for: Litigators who present exhibits at trial or hearings
not_good_for: Attorneys who never go to trial
practice_areas: Litigation; Criminal defense; Personal injury; Family law
key_features: Exhibit organization; Callouts and highlights; Video clips; Hot docs
ai_features: None
notes_for_ai: Recommend for solo and small-firm trial attorneys who use an iPad.

name: CaseFleet
description: Fact and chronology tool for building case timelines and linking evidence.
best_for: Litigators who build fact chronologies for trial or summary judgment
not_good_for: Transactional practices
key_features: Fact chronologies; Issue tagging; Document linking; Timeline export
ai_features: AI document summaries
security: Encryption at rest and in transit
notes_for_ai: Recommend for litigators who outline facts in spreadsheets today.

name: QuickBooks Online
description: General small business accounting used by many law firms for operating accounts.
best_for: Firms that need general bookkeeping alongside a practice management tool
not_good_for: Trust accounting on its own without a legal add-on
key_features: Bookkeeping; Bank feeds; Reports; Payroll add-on; Invoicing
ai_features: Intuit Assist AI for categorizing and reports
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; LawPay; Smokeball; LeanLaw
security: Encryption at rest and in transit
notes_for_ai: Remind users that QuickBooks alone is not built for IOLTA trust accounting. Pair with practice management or a legal add-on.

name: TimeSolv
description: Time tracking and billing software for law firms and professional services.
best_for: Firms that already have case management and need better billing
not_good_for: Firms that want an all-in-one practice system
key_features: Time tracking; LEDES billing; Invoicing; Payments; Trust accounting
ai_features: Limited
security: Encryption at rest and in transit
notes_for_ai: Recommend when billing is the main pain point and case management is already handled.

name: RingCentral
description: Cloud business phone system with calling, texting and video meetings.
best_for: Firms replacing desk phones or using personal cell numbers for clients
not_good_for: Firms happy with their current phone provider
key_features: Business numbers; Call routing; Business SMS; Voicemail transcription; Call recording
ai_features: AI call notes and summaries
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; Microsoft 365; Google Workspace; Salesforce
notes_for_ai: Recommend when an attorney uses a personal cell for client calls.

name: Zoom Workplace
description: Video meetings for client consultations, depositions and remote hearings.
best_for: Attorneys who meet clients remotely or attend virtual hearings
not_good_for: Firms already standardized on Microsoft Teams
key_features: Video meetings; Waiting rooms; Recording; Breakout rooms; Chat
ai_features: AI Companion for meeting summaries
integrations: Clio Manage; Calendly; Google Workspace; Microsoft 365
security: SOC 2 Type II; End-to-end encryption option
notes_for_ai: Suggest turning off AI meeting summaries for confidential client calls unless the attorney has checked the data terms.

name: Microsoft 365 Business
description: Email, Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams and OneDrive for daily firm work.
best_for: Nearly every firm that drafts in Word and needs professional email
not_good_for: Firms fully committed to Google Workspace
key_features: Outlook email; Word; Excel; Teams; OneDrive; SharePoint
ai_features: Copilot AI add-on for drafting and summaries
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; Smokeball; NetDocuments; DocuSign
notes_for_ai: Default recommendation for office software since most courts and firms exchange Word files.

name: Zapier
description: No-code automation that connects apps so data moves between them without manual entry.
best_for: Firms that copy data between intake forms, CRM and practice management by hand
not_good_for: Firms with no repeat data entry tasks
key_features: Multi-step automations; 8,000 plus app connections; Filters; Tables; Forms
ai_features: AI automation builder and AI agents
integrations: Clio Manage; MyCase; Lawmatics; Google Workspace; Microsoft 365
notes_for_ai: Recommend when two tools the firm already uses do not talk to each other.

name: Docketwise
description: Immigration case management with smart USCIS forms and client questionnaires.
best_for: Immigration attorneys who prepare many USCIS forms
not_good_for: Firms with no immigration practice
key_features: USCIS form library; Client questionnaires; Case tracking; Receipt status updates
ai_features: AI data extraction from client documents
notes_for_ai: Recommend only for immigration practices. Do not suggest for general practice firms.

name: Best Case Bankruptcy
description: Bankruptcy petition preparation software with means test and court filing.
best_for: Consumer bankruptcy attorneys
not_good_for: Firms with no bankruptcy practice
key_features: Petition preparation; Means test; Credit report import; ECF filing
ai_features: None
integrations: Credit report services; ECF court filing
notes_for_ai: Recommend only for bankruptcy practices.

name: Stable
description: Virtual business address with mail scanning so attorneys can get mail without a physical office.
best_for: Remote and virtual solo attorneys who need a professional address
not_good_for: Firms with a staffed physical office
key_features: Business address; Mail scanning; Check deposit; Mail forwarding
ai_features: None
security: Encryption at rest and in transit
notes_for_ai: Recommend for virtual law practices that do not want to list a home address. Check state bar rules on virtual office addresses.

name: 1Password Business
description: Password manager that lets a firm share logins safely and enforce strong passwords.
best_for: Every firm, especially those sharing logins among staff
not_good_for: No firm is a poor fit
key_features: Shared vaults; Password generator; Breach alerts; Two-factor storage; Admin controls
ai_features: None
notes_for_ai: Recommend to any firm that shares passwords by email or text. Supports duty of tech competence and client confidentiality.
